name: Spotify Premium Student
description: Spotify Premium plus Hulu for $6.99/month for students
fullDescription: Spotify offers college students Premium for $6.99/month (normally $12.99), with access to Hulu included. Available for up to 4 years while enrolled.
whatTheyOffer:
- Spotify Premium for $6.99/month (about 46% off)
- 1 month free for eligible new Premium users
- Ad-free music streaming
- Offline listening
- Hulu (with ads) included, subject to eligibility
- Available for up to 4 years (re-verify every 12 months)
howToGetIt:
1. Visit spotify.com/us/student
2. Verify enrollment through SheerID
3. Must be 18+ and enrolled at a Title IV accredited US college/university
4. Sign up or upgrade existing account
5. Re-verify student status every 12 months
keywords: Spotify, student discount, music streaming, Premium, Hulu, college, university
